name: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo
summary: Ember Bladewhisper seeks Blademaster Kaijo at a trainee camp north of the Horde outpost. His banner is meant to weaken the orcs’ morale and strengthen the resolve of Ember’s trainees.

sections.title: A Faltering Fight
sections.body: Ember Bladewhisper fears that each fallen orc is replaced by a more capable soldier. She believes a blademaster is training them, and says Kaijo is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost. You are asked to bring his banner to Farholde Keep.

sections.title: A Banner's Purpose
sections.body: Ember says the orc threat seems endless, and her soldiers’ resolve is fading. She hopes Kaijo’s banner will show her trainees that the Horde is nothing to fear.

faq.answer: Ember Bladewhisper identifies Kaijo as a blademaster who is likely training orcs at a trainee camp north of the Horde outpost.

faq.q: Why does Ember want Kaijo found?
faq.answer: Ember believes Kaijo is training a new generation of capable orc soldiers and fears their numbers will recover.

faq.q: Where does Ember think Kaijo is?
faq.answer: Ember says Kaijo is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost.

faq.q: What does Ember want brought to Farholde Keep?
faq.answer: Ember asks you to bring the Blademaster’s Banner to her at Farholde Keep.

faq.q: Why does Ember want the banner?
faq.answer: Ember hopes the banner will weaken orc morale and reassure her trainees that the Horde is nothing to fear.

faq.q: What worries Ember about the fight?
faq.answer: Ember fears the orc threat is unending and that her soldiers’ resolve is flagging.

attribution: In-game quest text: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo
